blocks.heading: Revolutionize Your Production with THT Auto Insertion Solutions

nodes.text: Revolutionize Your Production with THT Auto Insertion Solutions
Low-cost, high-efficiency automated solutions to replace manual THT component insertion and streamline your PCB assembly line.
Our Comprehensive THT Automation Solution
From standalone machines to fully integrated production lines, we provide flexible and powerful solutions to meet your specific needs.
High-Speed & Precision
Our machines offer insertion speeds of up to 0.4 seconds per component, ensuring maximum throughput without compromising on accuracy.
Cost-Effective Automation
Significantly reduce labor costs and improve consistency by replacing manual insertion processes. Achieve a rapid return on investment.
Flexible & Modular
Our solutions are designed to grow with you. Start with a single machine and expand to a full inline system as your production needs evolve.
Our THT Product Line
Engineered for reliability and performance, our machines handle a wide range of components.
AI-6488 Jumper Wire Inserter
High-speed insertion of jumper wires to replace traditional manual processes. Enhances connectivity and structural integrity of PCBs.
AI-6188 Radial Component Inserter
Versatile machine for inserting radial components like capacitors, LEDs, and transistors with high accuracy.
AI-6288 Axial Component Inserter
Reliably inserts axial components such as resistors and diodes, crucial for a wide range of electronic circuits.

blocks.heading: Your Trusted Partner for SMT & THT Solutions

nodes.text: Your Trusted Partner for SMT & THT Solutions
Established in the bustling tech hub of Shenzhen in 2011, Southern Machinery stands as a testament to innovation, quality, and efficiency in the electronics manufacturing industry.

With a keen focus on the Surface Mount Technology (SMT) and Through-Hole Technology (THT) sectors, our company specializes in the design and manufacture of state-of-the-art machinery and equipment aimed at revolutionizing PCB assembly automation processes.

Our commitment to enhancing assembly automation extends beyond our machinery. We are pioneers in incorporating the rich manufacturing experience of Shenzhen—a city renowned for its electronics production prowess—into our operations, products, and services.
